create_interface_config: create an InterfaceConfig object with a slab, adsorbates, solvent, and ions to generate solvated interface configurations
create_interface_on_sites: build solvent and ion interface configurations on top of existing adsorbate-slab atoms using packmol packing
create_packmol_atoms: pack solvent molecules and ions into a unit cell volume using packmol with a given geometry
run_packmol: run the packmol executable with an input file to pack molecules in a specified volume
randomize_coords: randomly place atoms within their unit cell by setting their center of mass to a random fractional coordinate
